summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are waiting for the train when they notice a group of people leaving work on a Sunday. Once they boarded the train, the group finds their co-worker dead in an empty train car. Location: Train (JR Yamanote Line) car 2 Victim: Kiyomi Hashimoto Cause of death: Blowdart poisoning Suspects: Seiji Kurata, Shizuka Kawai, and Yukiko Mori Seiji found Kiyomi in train seat, but when he touched her to wake her up, the body fell onto the train floor dead. After all three are presented as possible suspects Conan notices a couple of clues, there is a mark on her ear and a line on her arm.
